blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The best defense that Vice President Sara Duterte could have come up for the unexplained wealth allegations against her was to declare all assets and business interests in her Statement of Assets, Liabilities, and Net Worth (SALN), Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong claimed on Thursday. In a press briefing at the Batasang Pambansa complex, Alonto Adiong — who is one of the prosecution panel’s spokespersons — reminded Duterte that the government is not her property, and that she was merely elected by the people who trusted her to use these funds properly.
